title: Incandescent Manipulations
subtitle: Lux — blood remembers light
text: The Incandescent tendency belongs to blood that has witnessed things that glow — bioluminescent creatures, deep lava, long exposure to sunlight. Blood Lamp (QUICK, 75): compress blood into a small sphere of light and place it as a persistent lamp. Hemosynthesis (QUICK, 200): channel blood energy directly into plant growth or food production. Crimson Sight (QUICK, 250): push the light sensitivity of your blood outward, revealing hidden mobs, entities, and ore through stone and darkness for a brief window.
